# /assets/js/vendor/ — GSAP files go here

Before activating this theme, download GSAP and place these two files in this folder:

1. gsap.min.js
2. ScrollTrigger.min.js

Download from: https://gsap.com/docs/v3/Installation/
(Click "Download GSAP" on that page — both files are included in the zip)

Both files are FREE as of April 2025 with no account required.

If these files are missing, functions.php will automatically fall back to the
CDN versions from cdn.jsdelivr.net so the site still works — but for production,
local hosting is recommended for reliability and cache control.
